# Medium stamina mead

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadStaminaMedium | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Medium stamina x1 | Duration: 2s | Cooldown: 2m | Stamina Regen: +160 Stamina over 2s

# Introduction

Medium stamina mead is a Plains-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Medium stamina.

## Recipe

Mead base: Medium stamina is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Honey
• 10 Cloudberries
• 10 Yellow mushroom
Six Medium stamina meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

## Effect

Upon consumption, it restores 160 stamina over 2 seconds.
A 2-min cooldown is applied preventing consumption of another stamina mead.

Categorias: Mead, Fermenter recipes, Items
